BIOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BIOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growth and Development in Animals ● Metamorphosis (complete and incomplete metam? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growth and Development in Animals ● Metamorphosis (complete and incomplete metam.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Growth and Development in Animals ● Metamorphosis (complete and incomplete metam.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growth and Development in Animals ● Metamorphosis (complete and incomplete metam.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growth and Development in Animals ● Metamorphosis (complete and incomplete metam.

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

3. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ecology ● Ecosystems ● Adaptations of organisms to different habitats (xerophyte? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ecology ● Ecosystems ● Adaptations of organisms to different habitats (xerophyte.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ecology ● Ecosystems ● Adaptations of organisms to different habitats (xerophyte.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Ecology ● Ecosystems ● Adaptations of organisms to different habitats (xerophyte.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ecology ● Ecosystems ● Adaptations of organisms to different habitats (xerophyte.

5. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 0 °C

7. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Taxonomy II ● Kingdom Plantae (general characteristics of organisms in Divisions? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Taxonomy II ● Kingdom Plantae (general characteristics of organisms in Divisions.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Taxonomy II ● Kingdom Plantae (general characteristics of organisms in Divisions.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Taxonomy II ● Kingdom Plantae (general characteristics of organisms in Divisions.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Taxonomy II ● Kingdom Plantae (general characteristics of organisms in Divisions.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Excretion in Plants 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Reproduction in An? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Excretion in Plants 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Reproduction in An.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Excretion in Plants 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Reproduction in An.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Excretion in Plants 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Reproduction in An.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Excretion in Plants 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Reproduction in An.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Reproduction in Animals ● External fertilisation in animals ● Types of internal ? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Reproduction in Animals ● External fertilisation in animals ● Types of internal .
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Reproduction in Animals ● External fertilisation in animals ● Types of internal .
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Reproduction in Animals ● External fertilisation in animals ● Types of internal .
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Reproduction in Animals ● External fertilisation in animals ● Types of internal .

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Reproduction in Plants ● Asexual reproduction (Sporulation and vegetative propag? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Reproduction in Plants ● Asexual reproduction (Sporulation and vegetative propag.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Reproduction in Plants ● Asexual reproduction (Sporulation and vegetative propag.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Reproduction in Plants ● Asexual reproduction (Sporulation and vegetative propag.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Reproduction in Plants ● Asexual reproduction (Sporulation and vegetative propag.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Taxonomy I ● Meaning and significance of taxonomy ● Taxonomic units and nomencla and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Ecology ● Ecosystems ● Adaptations of organisms to different habitats (xerophyte and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Taxonomy II ● Kingdom Plantae (general characteristics of organisms in Divisions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Cell Division ● Meaning of cell division and structure of chromosomes ● Types of and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
